entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. Yes. I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and it's just... it's not right. I'm a bit lost on what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins. Order number is... uh... VF88-675-309. I have it right here.
Thank you, Sarah. I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's the color. On the website, it looked like a bright yellow, but in person, it's more of a muted gold. It doesn't match my gear at all, and I'm worried about road safety and visibility with this darker shade.
I understand completely. So it's a color preference issue, and you haven't used the helmet at all?

Oh, no, definitely not. The box is unopened, right on my table. I just looked through the little plastic window and knew it was wrong. I've just been so overwhelmed I didn't know what to do. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Sarah. That's what I'm here for. Let me just check the delivery date. It looks like it was delivered to you on December 12th, about 39 days ago. Let me pull up our policy.
Oh no, is that too long? The website was so confusing, I wasn't sure.
Not at all. For a standard item like this helmet, VeloFit has a 90-day return policy. Since you're well within that window and the box is unopened, we can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! Thank you so much. I was so worried.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy to help. I am sending a prepaid return label to the email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you, Alex. You've made this so easy.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
